thread:
Maggie Chen: Quick kickoff for the 'Sprout' micro-launch funnel. Objective: improve 7-day activation by 12-18% using gated free credits + 3 onboarding prompt templates + a short, pragmatic webinar.
Ashok Patel: Thinking about nudge copy: we should test emotional vs pragmatic vs ROI messaging. 3 arms ok?
Jordan Lee: 3 arms + holdout. We'll randomize at signup and track activation_7d.
Tia Gomez: Gating credits behind first quickstart run (run any prompt template) to improve signal on intent.
Samir Rao: I'll implement tagging: sprout_onboard_v2026 and webhook for credit issuance. ETA later today.
product-bot: Reminder: webinar registration page live in 36h.
Eva Alvarez: Running benchmark sweep tonight. We'll include two slides: latency (50-512 tokens) and cost per 1k tokens vs baseline model.
Ashok Patel: I'll write 3 template prompts: support-reply, thread-summarizer, quick-code-refactor. Keep them 2-3 turns max.
Maggie Chen: Experiment config draft:
```
experiment_id: sprout_microlaunch_2026
variants: [holdout, emotional, pragmatic, roi]
primary_metric: activation_7d
secondary_metrics: usage_14d, retention_30d
cohort_tag: sprout_onboard_v2026
```
Jordan Lee: Webinar plan: 12m demo, 10m quickstart walkthrough using prompt templates, 18m Q&A. Need a short benchmark blurb for hero banner that says "Redwood inference: lower latency and predictable cost" with numbers post-sweep.
Tia Gomez: Routing: tag webinar signups with sprout-webinar and route to SDR A/B by timezone. I'll post the HubSpot playbook once done.
Samir Rao: Credit issuance snippet I'll use:
```
POST /internal/credits
{ "user": "<id>", "cohort": "sprout_onboard_v2026", "credits": 40 }
```
Eva Alvarez: Benchmarks will be posted tomorrow morning. I'll include variance and config (model, seq-length, batch).
Maggie Chen: Great. Follow-ups: Samir (webhook + tag + smoke test), Ashok (templates + nudge copy), Eva (benchmarks + blurb), Tia (routing + playbook), Jordan & I (slides + webinar script). 11am dry run tomorrow.
Jordan Lee: 11am confirmed. :thumbsup:
Maggie Chen: Thanks team. I'll update the Notion doc and share the final checklist.
